tagline: The 1Password Event Logs connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in Beta.
what_it_does: The 1Password Event Logs connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in Beta. Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the Previews page. The connector uses the 1Password Events API to ingest audit events, item usages, and sign in attempts into Databricks.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
plain_summary: The 1Password Event Logs connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in Beta. Workspace admins can control access to this feature from the Previews page.
key_takeaway: The 1Password Event Logs connector is now available in Lakeflow Connect in Beta.
